name: NGC 6822 SC3 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 6822 SC3, a globular cluster of the dwarf irregular galaxy NGC 6822, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc6822sc3-hubble
story: SC3 is one of the globular clusters closest to the heart of NGC 6822, an isolated dwarf irregular galaxy. Hubble's deep view resolves its stars, and the new data suggest the cluster is older than earlier estimates.

claims.text: NGC6822-SC3 is a globular cluster target of Hubble program 15336
NGC 6822 is an isolated dwarf irregular galaxy
NGC 6822 is a Local Group dwarf irregular galaxy
SC3 is one of the innermost globular clusters of NGC 6822
SC3 is an extended globular cluster
The new Hubble data suggest SC3 is older than an earlier estimate
The study uses deep Hubble photometry resolving cluster stars
